idle.name: idle
idle.section: ### `idle`: fighting stance (breathing loop) 8 frames · loops · **CORE** · bodyHeight 204 · ms 150/150/150/150/150/150/150/150 · prompt A01 (2 images: f0–f3 + f4–f7) The neutral stance and the key pose for the whole sheet. Every other animation starts and ends close to f0. It must read instantly as a serious, athletic fighter: grounded, balanced, ready to drive forward. - **Hair and cloth:** A small breathing bob done with the knees only (feet never move). Hair spikes and side locks lag the body by one frame. Headband tails hang behind the head and sway gently; the jacket hem moves 1 px with the breath. - **QA:** Landmarks per CHARACTER.md §3: hair top y 36, skull top y 52, eyes y 66-70, chin y 83, shoulders y 92, crotch y 152, knees y 196, soles y 240 (trimmed height about 204 px, head about 31 px). L (lead) fist about (176, 86), R fist about (154, 98). Idle front edge about x 182: nothing in idle reaches further right (the packer finds attack hitboxes from this edge minus 9 px, about x 174). Feet: L toes about x 176, R heel about x 84. | f | file | phase | pose | face | notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | f0 | `idle_00` | key | KEY POSE. Orthodox fighting stance: L (lead) foot forward with the toes pointing right, R foot back and turned out about 45°, feet a little wider than the shoulders, knees bent about 20°, weight centered on the balls of the feet. Torso upright with a slight forward lean, chest turned about 35° toward the viewer, shoulders relaxed and broad. With 6.5-head proportions the stride is long, so keep it inside the cell. - **Hair and cloth:** Torso pitched forward about 40° for the whole cycle, head raised and looking ahead. Both arms stay extended straight back behind the body, slightly raised, hands open and flat with fingers together; they bob up and down 2 px. Hips stay over the midpoint between the feet. Hair, side locks and headband tails stream straight back (left) the whole time, tails waving up and down; the jacket hem and pant legs flap back. - **QA:** The R leg (near) is drawn over the L leg where they overlap. Keep the hips over the midpoint between the feet so the packer's feet-center alignment does not make the body slide between frames. The longest frames (f3, f7) stay inside x 4-251: front knee or foot and head reach about x 200-215, the trailing arms and the back foot about x 30-60. | f | file | phase | pose | face | notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | f0 | `run_00` | loop | Contact: L foot reaching forward, heel touching down well ahead of the hips; R leg extended far back, toes pushing off. ## Changing an animation

- Frame counts and phases come from `src/art/animGuide.js` and `art/manifest.json`. If a strip comes
  out better with a different frame count, that's allowed (the engine spreads frames over the move
  phases), but update the manifest entry (`frames`, `phases`) and this file together, and say so
  in CHANGELOG.md.
- Keep the active frames inside their ADR 0007 contact zones. They are tuned to the move ranges in
  `src/game/moves.js`. If a move feels like it whiffs at close range, check the hitbox in the
  Sprite Lab before redrawing. A `hitboxes.json` override may be all it needs (MOVES_AND_VFX.md §6).
- Body heights are the ADR 0007 table. If an approved strip packs visibly bigger or smaller than idle
  (compare head sizes, about 31 px), Codex corrects that animation's `bodyHeight` in the manifest
  and notes it in TRACKER.md; don't redraw for it.
